name: MEDDPICC

elements.name: Metrics
elements.definition: Metrics: what the buyer has said, on the record, about this part of the decision.
questions: What does this problem cost you today, in days or money?
How many days does the close take today, and who tracks it?
Who reports the close time to the board, and what is it costing you now?
evidenceSignals: A consequence stated by the buyer

anchors.1: Mentioned in general terms, nothing specific, or only the rep talking.
anchors.2: Specific and quoted from the buyer: a name, a number, a step or a date.
anchors.3: Confirmed by the buyer with ownership or consequence, and consistent across interactions.

exampleQuotes.1: We know the close is slow but nobody has put a number on it.
exampleQuotes.2: Month-end close takes us 11 days; we need it under 5 by the next audit.
exampleQuotes.3: Our CFO signed off the target: close in 5 days by Q4, which she values at about 200k a year in audit and overtime.

elements.nextQuestionAt1: How many days does the close take today, and who tracks it?
failureModes: Rep asserts it instead of the buyer saying it
